attchmntText: Cochin Shipyard Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Cochin Shipyard Limited filed copies of newspaper advertisements regarding its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The filing was submitted to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. on November 11, 2026. The document serves as a routine compliance update for the exchange records.

attchmntText: Cochin Shipyard Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ' Receipt of order for Normal refit cum re-powering of an Indian Naval Vessel'.
voiceSummary: Cochin Shipyard Limited signed a contract with the Ministry of Defence on November 11, 2026, for the normal refit cum re-powering of an Indian Naval Vessel. The estimated contract value is approximately Rs. 500 crore. The project duration is around 2 years. None of the promoters, promoter group, or group companies have any interest in the entity that awarded the order. The order does not fall under the purview of related party transactions.

attchmntText: Cochin Shipyard Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Communication on Tax Deduction at Source (TDS) on Dividend payout - 01st Interim Dividend 2026-27'.
voiceSummary: Cochin Shipyard Limited declared a first interim dividend of Rs. 3.00 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. The Board approved this on November 10, 2026. Payment is scheduled by December 09, 2026. The record date is November 16, 2026. Tax deduction at source applies. Resident shareholders face a 10% TDS rate. An exemption exists if annual dividends do not exceed Rs. 10,000. Non-resident shareholders face a 20% TDS rate. Documents must be submitted to MUFG Intime India Private Limited by November 16, 2026. This deadline applies to all tax exemption or lower rate claims.

attchmntText: Cochin Shipyard Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 16-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: Cochin Shipyard Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board declared an interim dividend of Rs. 3 per equity share. The record date is November 16, 2026, with payment due by December 09, 2026. The auditor’s report highlights suspension of construction for two passenger vessels with bank guarantees of Rs. 112,412 lakhs pending renewal. Hooghly Cochin Shipyard Limited faces lease accounting discrepancies and a Rs. 55 lakh provision for delayed lease rent interest. A Rs. 783 lakh provision was made for interest on unspent project funds payable to the Inland Waterways Authority of India. Construction of a caisson gate is delayed with Rs. 1,632 lakhs spent. Income of Rs. 611 lakhs was recognized under the Ship Building Financial Assistance Policy.

attchmntText: Cochin Shipyard Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proceedings of Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: Cochin Shipyard Limited reports that members passed two resolutions via remote e-Voting on November 07, 2026. The first resolution, a special resolution for the transfer of the ISRF Undertaking under Section 180(1)(a) of the Companies Act, 2013, received 20,09,68,378 votes in favor and 8,020 against. The second resolution, an ordinary resolution regarding a material related party transaction with a joint venture company proposed to be incorporated with Drydocks World – Dubai FZCO, received 3,43,46,389 votes in favor and 7,481 against. The scrutinizer, CS Sreekumar P. S., submitted the report on November 09, 2026. The e-Voting period ran from October 09, 2026, to November 07, 2026. The cut-off date for eligibility was October 06, 2026.

attchmntText: Cochin Shipyard Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Postal Ballot. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
voiceSummary: Cochin Shipyard Limited announces that resolutions from the Postal Ballot Notice dated October 08, 2026, have been passed with the requisite majority. The voting results were submitted to BSE Limited and NSE on November 09, 2026. Resolution one, a special resolution regarding the transfer of the ISRF Undertaking, passed with 99.9960 percent votes in favor. Resolution two, an ordinary resolution concerning a material related party transaction with Drydocks World Dubai FZCO, passed with 99.9782 percent votes in favor. The e-voting period was open from October 09, 2026, to November 07, 2026. CS Sreekumar P S served as the scrutinizer. The voting results and the scrutinizer's report are available on the company website and CDSL portal.
